// GENERATED by MONSTERA Studio test-build - written once into extensions/, yours to edit after export
package monstera.studio.scaffold

// MOCK: Scaffold only: this file contacts no service and holds no key. It shows no ad and grants a reward only to the callback you pass.

class MockRewardedAdService(
    private val placements: List<AdPlacement> = AdPlacements.ALL,
    private val log: (String) -> Unit = { println(it) },
) : AdService {
    companion object { const val IS_MOCK: Boolean = true }
    override val isMock: Boolean = IS_MOCK
    private val shownCount = HashMap<String, Int>()
    private val lastShown = HashMap<String, Int>()

    private fun find(id: String): AdPlacement? = placements.firstOrNull { it.id == id }

    override fun canShow(placementId: String, nowSeconds: Int): Boolean {
        val p = find(placementId) ?: return false
        return FrequencyLimit.canShow(p.minSecondsBetween, p.maxPerSession, shownCount[placementId] ?: 0, lastShown[placementId] ?: -1, nowSeconds)
    }

    override fun show(placementId: String, nowSeconds: Int, onReward: (rewardKind: String, rewardAmount: Int) -> Unit): Boolean {
        val p = find(placementId) ?: return false
        if (!canShow(placementId, nowSeconds)) { log("[MOCK AD] " + placementId + " skipped by frequency limit"); return false }
        shownCount[placementId] = (shownCount[placementId] ?: 0) + 1
        lastShown[placementId] = nowSeconds
        log("[MOCK AD] " + placementId + " simulated, no ad was shown")
        if (p.type == "rewarded") onReward(p.rewardKind, p.rewardAmount)
        return true
    }
}
